# ElizaOS Project Summary: July 16, 2026

On July 16, 2026, the ElizaOS team focused on scaling infrastructure and refining core agent operations, highlighted by the launch of `@elizaos/eliza-hub` and a major codebase cleanup that removed 8,000 lines of dead code. Development efforts centered on improving cloud-native reliability, optimizing inference performance, and stabilizing cross-platform interactions across Discord and mobile.

## ✅ Completed Work

**Infrastructure & Developer Experience**
*   **Framework Expansion:** Introduced `@elizaos/eliza-hub`, a new workspace package featuring an Eliza-themed Forgejo deployment and an agent-native "Merge Steward" queue ([elizaos/eliza#16170](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16170)).
*   **CI/CD Optimization:** Streamlined release workflows and cleaned up benchmark/scenario configurations to improve maintainability ([elizaos/eliza#16284](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16284), [elizaos/eliza#16466](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16466)).

**Cloud & Account Management**
*   **Reliability Enhancements:** Improved account-pool stability through a new lease broker, better credential health management, and refined reconciliation for failed usage probes ([elizaos/eliza#16355](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16355), [elizaos/eliza#16365](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16365), [elizaos/eliza#16368](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16368)).
*   **API Heartbeats:** Implemented per-minute cloud-api DB heartbeats and org-scoped idempotency keys to ensure robust credit reservations ([elizaos/eliza#16415](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16415), [elizaos/eliza#16444](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16444)).

**Core Inference & UI Stability**
*   **Inference Tuning:** Added `maxReplyTokens` for per-agent reply-length budgeting and optimized model-call span windows ([elizaos/eliza#16401](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16401), [elizaos/eliza#16406](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16406)).
*   **Platform Fixes:** Resolved critical Discord routing bugs and mobile cold-launch re-onboarding issues, while redesigning the `ChatOverlay` as a liquid-glass system surface ([elizaos/eliza#16503](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16503), [elizaos/eliza#16502](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16502), [elizaos/eliza#16489](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16489), [elizaos/eliza#16326](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16326)).
